name: constraint-scope
body: The constraint-scope law, enforced on the write surface and carried on the scan surface: `rust.apg.layers.write.validate_change` refuses a new or changed constraint `attaches-to` whose target is absent or in the wrong layer, while `rust.apg.layers.validate.eval_constraint` is the shared structural check both the write path and the scan path call. The scan path `rust.apg.layers.tree.ingest_tree` loads an existing constraint carrying an `attaches-to`, and `apg spec lint` reports it.
